Good choice
Mar 2025 • Friends
Alfresco Hai Ba Trung in Hanoi offers a pleasant and efficient dining experience, ideal for team lunches. The service was commendable, though there is room for improvement, particularly concerning drink service, which lacked the promptness seen with the food. The dishes arrived swiftly, a notable plus, and the quality of the food was consistent and satisfying, meeting the expectations of a modern international eatery. The ambiance was also conducive to a relaxed and enjoyable gathering, making it a solid choice for casual business events. Despite the minor service hiccups, the overall experience was positive, and I left with a sense of contentment.

Duy Đ
1 contribution

My favorite restaurant for Western food
Aug 2021
I knew this restaurant when my family tried it. Its walls, decoration style is pretty classic, I love the cozy and airy atmosphere inside it. Many people also love this restaurant, so on the weekends, it's quite full. I always choose spaghetti as my main dish, my family chooses steaks and french fries as the side dish. It tastes very good. The presentation of the spaghetti dish is beautiful. The sauce is placed nicely in the center of the dish. The steaks are excellent, they never overcooked them. It's reasonable that the prices are a little bit expensive. And I can understand that they bring the food quite slowly because there're often full of customers.
After all, I think that this restaurant is very good, and I'll recommend it for anyone that loves Western food, especially spaghetti. My advice for this restaurant is maybe lowering the prices a bit. Because of that, I can't eat here very often.
